# Sparksi

> Peelsa model manager for NVIDIA DGX Spark clusters of one to four Sparks.

Sparksi is the Peelsa model manager for NVIDIA DGX Spark (one to four Sparks). A controller (`sparksi serve`, port 7500) serves a dashboard and HTTP API; each Spark runs a stdlib-only announcer sending UDP to port 7501; node operations go over SSH with a stdlib-only agent sent per request. Requires Python 3.12+; the only dependency is PyYAML. Config lives in `~/.config/sparksi/sparksi.toml` (site values) and `catalog.yaml` (models); neither is committed. Declare 1-4 `[[nodes]]`: head, worker, Spark 3, Spark 4 in file order. Multi-Spark runs use exactly two Sparks. Only the last Spark can be removed. Recipes are named per model (suggested `model-quant-concurrency-kvcache-notes`), with exactly one default per model. The lock is ON by default; Load, Unload, Restart, Network edits and saving a GPU max-clock cap on Overview need Unlock, and Load, Unload and Restart ask for confirmation with the model, machines and port. A GPU clock cap also asks first if a model is running on that Spark; the cap is not kept across a reboot. The browser sends fields, never shell strings. Port 8188 is never started, stopped or probed. Dashboard pages: Overview, Model Manager, Library, Archive, Network, Options, Token totals, Activity.
